scope: Reported torque fluctuations; includes real servo effort, quantization and sensor noise. Not raw current or independent torque accuracy.
motion_error: Pilot J7 reported speed exceeds original 3 deg/s guard
stop_timestamp_kind: rosbag receive time, not motor brake-onset time
psd_assumption: Nominal 100Hz adapter stream, longest continuous portion of stationary 20s baseline; no interpolation or joining across gaps. Reported torque spectrum up to 50Hz only, no PWM/ADC spectrum inferred.
